decisions_log.decision: Scope (user): Gmail compose/reply translation only; no incoming email translation, no summaries
Register (user): follow the thread's formality; new email with no thread is neutral-polite; writer is male
Trigger is an explicit Translate button next to Send plus Alt+T; Enter is never intercepted; the extension never sends
Target language auto: the model writes in the language of the latest thread message from them (else English) and reports lang; picker overrides
Body write is a direct DOM replace of the user's part plus an input event; execCommand insertText cloned the quote block's class in the spike
No storage for email: no cache, no per-thread state, no Korean-original record
Unit tests use a synthetic Gmail fixture shaped by the spike instead of a sanitized live snapshot, so no mail content can leak into the repo

continuation_prompt: Gmail compose translation plan written and self-reviewed (8 tasks, 3 sprints; Sprint 1 spike done). Next: execute Sprint 2 (Tasks 2-3), then Sprint 3 (Tasks 4-8, Task 8 is the live check where the user sends).
